intro: A fine sash bearing embroidered initials hints at a rightful owner somewhere in Stranglethorn Vale. Finding the seafarer who lost it leads on to The Captain's Cutlass.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
paras: You recovered my sash? Then...you must have killed Mok'rash the sea giant! Hooray!
I'm glad the scurvy villain's dead - Mok'rash was one of three sea giants who smashed my ships and killed my crew.
You are an adventurer of worth, friend.
